nodes.label: Performance Rules
nodes.rationale: Slow parts are router API calls and LibreQoS reload: parallel tokio task per router, persistent sessions, per-call timeouts, SHA-256 hash skip, atomic rename (lqosd watcher rejects symlinks), active/idle intervals.

nodes.label: Router State Machine (online/failed/unreachable/offline)
nodes.rationale: Failed router keeps its subscribers; offline router loses them after offline_after (ADR-0003). Only online routers remove inactive subscribers.

nodes.label: DHCP server discovery (like PPP)
nodes.rationale: updatecsv.py reads only listed DHCP servers; operator wants DHCP dynamic like PPP so a new server needs no config change. Disabled servers skipped; discover=false uses only listed servers. Consequence: a new server is shaped at once with the default rate.

nodes.label: Exclusions ([exclude] / [routers.exclude]: dhcp_servers, ppp_profiles, ips)
nodes.rationale: Live router has a management DHCP server that must not be shaped; both global and per-router lists apply. Excluded subscribers leave via normal removal so the removal guard protects large changes.

nodes.label: Case-insensitive * wildcard name matching
nodes.rationale: Regular expressions rejected: more power but easy to get wrong; wildcards cover operator cases. ips accept IPv4 and CIDR; loader rejects bad address or empty name.

nodes.label: Name templates ([nodes], [circuits])
nodes.rationale: Changing a [circuits] template on a live system gives new Circuit Names, so old rows are removed and re-added with new IDs.

nodes.label: Removal guard ([safety])
nodes.rationale: A bad router reply can make many subscribers disappear in one cycle; hold the removal until the next cycle confirms it.

nodes.label: Circuit rate clamp formula (max_floor_mbps, safe_min_mbps)
nodes.rationale: LibreQoS 2.2 and v3 reject max below 0.2 and min below 0.1 Mbps.

nodes.label: ADR-0001 One model, many writers
nodes.rationale: One crate, one circuit model, one writer per target; collector/speed rules/topology/validator shared. Pair-only lacks v3 strict gate, stable IDs, VLAN/MPLS; network-only needs a 2.2 converter anyway. Status accepted.

nodes.label: ADR-0002 v3 target selection
nodes.rationale: Auto-select per cycle from version and v3 topology source; fixed TOML target overrides. Rejected fixed-only (upgrade writes wrong format) and write-all (confusing). Status proposed pending v3 test shaper.

nodes.label: Speed rules decision (routeros_rx_tx, unitless bps)
nodes.rationale: Operator selected RouterOS-correct rate order and units.

nodes.label: Comment speed format (Name|25M/5M, 25M/5M, 25M)
nodes.rationale: Form 3 accepts only M, and the unit must end the word, so 'Wifi 5G' or '5Main' is not a speed.

nodes.label: offline_after / offline_action
nodes.rationale: Offline means only the API path is down; remove may unshape subscribers still passing traffic, so make offline_after longer than usual outages.

nodes.label: Policy in TOML, formats in code
nodes.norm_label: policy in toml, formats in code
nodes.rationale: RouterOS API paths, ShapedDevices.csv columns, file names and libreqos_network.json schema are fixed by LibreQoS/RouterOS, so they stay in code.

nodes.label: Router state classification (RouterResult, unreachable_since)
nodes.rationale: Only TCP connect refused/timed out is Unreachable; login refused, TLS error, !trap, timeout are Failed. TLS certificate error is Failed because it is a config problem.
